Alex / Samir —

Thanks, Alex. Samir — nice to meet you over email. The proposed window looks workable. Two small asks from our side:

1) Panel sequencing: can we tighten back-to-back where possible to keep candidate momentum. If we keep 10-minute buffers as Alex suggested, let's move the coding slot earlier so interviewers have time to prep the pairing environment. New suggested order: 9:00 system design, 9:30 coding, 10:10 deep dive, 10:40 manager.

2) Debrief leads: Laura, can you own the technical synthesis (system design + coding)? Karthik — can you take the product/manager debrief and consolidate final score? Marissa — can you own the logistics/candidate care (send calendar invites, Zoom links, short prep note)?

We'll use the attached eval sheet (eval_template_v2.xlsx) — please keep notes tied to rubric fields. I'll circulate the final calendar once Alex confirms Samir's time.

Thanks all — short answers ok here.

Best,
Evelyn
